messages:
sam (customer): hey @support — urgent: POST /v1/tools invoked 'subscription.pause' but system ran 'subscription.charge' and billed the customer. Request id: req_0a1b2c3d, trace t-9f8e7. Payload I sent:
```json
{"tool": "subscription.pause", "args": {"subscription_id": "sub_12345", "pause_until": null}}
```
Can you roll back the charge and audit call graph?

support-bot: Ticket INC-4023 created and assigned to zoe (support).

zoe (support): on it. can you paste full request headers + request_ts?

sam (customer): headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxxx; request_ts: 1728999999. raw curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tool/invoke \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxxx' \
 -d '{"tool":"subscription.pause","args":{"subscription_id":"sub_12345","pause_until":null}}'
```
acct id: acct_987.

zoe (support): reproducing locally with same body — resolver logs show both pause and charge as candidates, and it selected subscription.charge because "pause_until" being null matched in a permissive way. logs:
```
[resolver] candidates: ['subscription.pause','subscription.charge']
[resolver] input_signature: {'subscription_id': 'str', 'pause_until': None}
[resolver] selected: subscription.charge (score=0.78)
[invoker] executed: subscription.charge request_id=req_0a1b2c3d
```

kevin (eng): pinging @eng-runtime — did we change resolver scoring last week?

eli (runtime): yes — PR #7124 modified tie-break to favor "monetary" verbs when ambiguous (intended to reduce failed refunds). looks like null/absent pause_until pushed score toward charge. PR: https://git.internal/r/7124. i'll prep an immediate rollback if confirmed.

zoe (support): sam — immediate remediation in progress: refund job created refund-449 (ETA ~30m). rotating the service token used for that request now. can you confirm customer email for notification?

sam (customer): alice@example.com. refund is ok for now; want root cause and prevention.

eli (runtime): next steps: revert PR7124 in prod, add stricter schema validation in resolver so pause schema requires an ISO date string (not null). opening ENG-981 for the schema fix + canary rollout.

kevin (eng): i'll add a unit test and a hotfix to strictly type-check pause_until. ETA ~2h. will also add an integration test to catch this routing class.

support-bot: INC-4023 updated: status=in-progress; owner=zoe (support); linked=ENG-981; rollback scheduled.

zoe (support): note for customer message: "We've issued a refund and are deploying a fix to avoid misrouting pause -> charge calls. We'll follow up with a postmortem." :thumbsup:

sam (customer): thanks — please include the minimal repro (curl above) in the postmortem.

eli (runtime): copying #eng-sre and #eng-runtime for monitoring; tagging oncall. :eyes:

zoe (support): logging this as a Sev-2 until rollback completes and refund clears.

sam (customer): appreciated.
